title: CHARGE THE COIL - Made this fun little coil charge game for the Itch Game Jam #4!
author: TriggerHydrant
selftext:
https://preview.redd.it/p50nnim86rgh1.png?width=2560&format=png&auto=webp&s=dfd3be63a0974b421eb3c2edf086e6ec6ffa649b

the theme this time is **Charge** and I was already working on a game concept that could be picked up right away, be fun to play, visually satisfying and be tight in terms of sound, scope and feel.   
Check it out here: [https://lifthillstudio.itch.io/charge-the-coil](https://lifthillstudio.itch.io/charge-the-coil)

comments.author: tastygnar
comments.body: Damn already pumping stuff out and it just started. I think you should add that its a timing game in the description somewhere.

replies.author: TriggerHydrant
replies.body: Oh thank you! That's a good one, I'll ad it!

replies.author: tastygnar
replies.body: Oh ok good to know, the wind release charge tag line through me off.  You might wamt to include a quick tutorial on first play that pauses the game at the exact right moment with some help text so the player can tap to continue and get the vibe.  Nice work!  Im still coming up with ideas for my contribution to the game jam,!

replies.author: TriggerHydrant
replies.body:
Appreciate you! I've deployed a new version and would love to have your feedback on it.

[https://lifthillstudio.itch.io/charge-the-coil](https://lifthillstudio.itch.io/charge-the-coil)

  
If you need some feedback or want to brainstorm some stuff for your game/jam feel free to hit me up in the DM's, I love to return the favour, cheers!

replies.author: tastygnar
replies.body:
Sweet!  Tried it again, the prompts help a lot!  Only thing id add is a break between levels, coil 2 starts a little too fast and I dont get to celebrate clearing coil 1.

Btw sounds are great, imo!

Ill post my game when its ready!

replies.author: TriggerHydrant
replies.body:
Good one! I'll make a little bit slower so new players get a feel before speeding it up!

Yes, would love to see what you come up with, cheers!
